families.skill: divide a whole number by a fraction
families.prompt: Work out ${n} \div \tfrac{{{a}}}{{{b}}}$, as a whole number or a fraction in its lowest terms.

wrong.line: You multiplied by $\tfrac{{{a}}}{{{b}}}$. Dividing asks how many portions of $\tfrac{{{a}}}{{{b}}}$ fit into ${n}$.
${n}$ holds ${pieces}$ pieces of size $\tfrac{{1}}{{{b}}}$, but a portion is ${a}$ of them, so divide by ${a}$ as well.

solution: Each portion of $\tfrac{{{a}}}{{{b}}}$ is ${a}$ of those pieces, so ${n} \div \tfrac{{{a}}}{{{b}}} = {pieces} \div {a} = {key:frac}$.

families.skill: divide a fraction by a fraction
families.prompt: Work out $\tfrac{{{a}}}{{{b}}} \div \tfrac{{{c}}}{{{d}}}$, as a whole number or a fraction in its lowest terms.

wrong.line: You multiplied by $\tfrac{{{c}}}{{{d}}}$. Dividing by it is multiplying by its upside-down, ${flip:frac}$.
You turned the first fraction upside down. Turn over the one you divide by, $\tfrac{{{c}}}{{{d}}}$.
